summary: RCO remains one active Mexican toll-road company but its legal form and ownership are stale in the repository. Primary filings support S.A.P.I. de C.V., Abertis at 53.12%, a GIC economic interest of approximately 29.04% within the 82.16% BBVA trust block, and the AFORE/HSBC block at 17.84%. Trustee substitutions and later capital actions did not change economic ownership; no later sale or pending ownership transaction was found.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: The current GIC affiliate/fund and individual AFORE beneficiaries and stakes are not publicly disclosed.
